learning_outcomes.text: Students will have basic knowledge of kinesiology.

They will be able to apply this knowledge interdisciplinarily, for example in the construction of sports equipment and facilities, in the design of ergonomic workplaces and motor vehicles, etc., and in optimal human-machine interactions.

syllabus_topics: Discussion of various models of human movement coordination
Sports motor skills tests and their automation
Behavioral and relational prevention at the workplace and in sports
assessment_rules: The module grade is based on a written or oral examination, contributing 100% to the final module grade.
